known_limitations: input halos floored at log10 Mvir >= 12.5; centrals in lower-mass halos are not realized (see ncen_at_input_floor for how much occupation the floor truncates for these HOD parameters)
central galaxies only; CMASS satellite fraction ~10% is ignored
halo masses are Rockstar Mvir; published HOD fits may use other definitions (e.g. M200b in Yuan et al. 2021)
